title: Fact or Fiction
core_loop: Statements appear one at a time — the player decides TRUE or FALSE with a swipe or tap before the 7-second timer expires. Correct: statement card flies toward 'Fact' pile with confetti, score increases, streak builds. Wrong: card crumples into 'Fiction' bin with screen shake, streak breaks, lose 1 of 3 credibility tokens. Every 5th statement is a 'Boss Fact' (harder, 2x points, 10s timer). Session ends at 0 tokens or 30 statements answered — final score = base + streak bonuses + boss bonuses + speed bonuses + survival bonus.
controls: Swipe right or tap green check = TRUE. Swipe left or tap red X = FALSE. Keyboard: Right Arrow / D = TRUE, Left Arrow / A = FALSE. Space = pass (costs 1 token, once per session, no streak penalty). No drag-hold, no multi-step — binary decision only, optimized for instant thumb reaction.
mechanics: 7-second countdown per statement (progress bar + numeric, pulses at 3s/1s)
Streak multiplier: 1x -> 1.3x at 3 -> 1.7x at 6 -> 2.2x at 10 -> 3x at 15 -> 4x at 21 (caps at 4x)
Speed bonus: +40 pts for <2s, +20 pts for <4s, +10 pts for <6s
Three credibility tokens (shield icons). Wrong answer: -1 token, streak resets, 200ms screen shake (8px)
Pass token: 1 per session, Space to skip (costs 1 token, no streak penalty, statement marked 'Skipped')
Boss Facts every 5th statement (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30): 2x base points, 10s timer, visual crown badge, distinctive sound
Difficulty tiers by statement index: 1-6 (common knowledge), 7-12 (general), 13-18 (specialized), 19-24 (expert), 25-30 (obscure)
Category tags shown per statement (Science, History, Pop Culture, Geography, Nature, Tech) — no category mastery mechanic, pure variety
Statement pool: 300+ curated statements (50 per category), balanced 50/50 true/false, shuffled per session, no repeats
Final score = sum(base * streak_mult + speed_bonus) + boss_bonuses (2x base) + survival_bonus (15 pts per remaining token)
juice: Statement card: subtle 3D tilt on hover/touch (follows thumb), springs back on release
TRUE decision: card slides right with elastic overshoot, green checkmark stamp, +points float up, streak bar fills with gold gradient
FALSE decision: card slides left, red X stamp, tokens: shield cracks -> shatters -> empty with particle burst
Boss Fact entrance: card scales up 1.2x with golden glow pulse, crown icon orbits, timer ring gold
Boss Fact correct: screen flash gold, confetti ring burst, 'BOSS CLEARED' badge, 100ms time dilation
Timer bar: smooth drain, color shifts green->yellow->red, emits 3 urgency ticks at 3s/2s/1s
Streak milestone (3/6/10/15/21): multiplier badge pops with scale bounce, brief chromatic aberration shader
Pass activation: card dissolves into sparkles, pass token grays with lock icon, 'PASSED' stamp
Category tag: color-coded pill (Science=cyan, History=sepia, Pop=magenta, Geo=green, Nature=emerald, Tech=blue), fades in with statement
Background: animated gradient mesh, hue shifts subtly per category tag, 60fps on 5-year-old mobile
Game Over: score breakdown animation (base -> streak -> speed -> boss -> survival), rank badge (S: 25k+, A: 18k+, B: 12k+, C: 7k+, D: 3k+, E: <3k), 'Play Again' button pulses with breathing scale
mvp_scope: Single-file HTML5 (800x600), Phaser 3, no external assets. All text via bitmap font (procedural atlas). Statements embedded as JSON array. Two large touch targets (TRUE/FALSE) as Phaser containers with rounded rects. Timer as horizontal progress bar with color gradient. Streak bar as segmented fill. Tokens as three shield containers. Category pill at top. Boss Fact crown overlay. Background: animated gradient mesh. GameOver scene with animated score breakdown and rank. 60fps target on 5-year-old mobile. Portrait-friendly: 9:16 safe zone, TRUE/FALSE buttons at bottom thumbs reach.
win_lose_condition: Lose: Credibility tokens reach 0 (3 wrong answers or 2 wrong + 1 pass). Win: Answer 30 statements without losing all tokens. Both end states show GameOver scene with animated score tally, rank (S/A/B/C/D/E), and restart button. Session length 45-75 seconds, designed for ad-length play. No mid-session save.
